observations: Photo 0 shows a used V8 engine block with a bolted-on transmission/gearbox, heavily soiled, resting on rubble/dirt ground.
Numerous wiring harnesses, sensors, and connectors are visible, some loose or disconnected.
Visible surface rust on bolts and some metal housings.
A watermark reading 'LOTCHIROKA INVESTMENT' is overlaid on both photos.
Photo 1 shows the same assembly from a different angle, with a man in an orange shirt standing behind it; no engine code, VIN, or model plate is legible in either photo.
No start-up, compression test, or diagnostic readout is shown in either photo.

identity.kind: used V8 engine and gearbox assembly (seller claims Lexus LS460 fitment)

claims.claim: LS460 Engine and Gear Box for Lexus Cars
claims.evidence: No engine code, VIN plate, or Lexus/Toyota branding is legible in photo 0 or photo 1; claim rests on seller's text only.

risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unverified V8 engine/gearbox, not model-specific

risks.risk: Wiring harness and sensors may be incomplete or damaged, affecting install cost

risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, assuming missing/damaged components

risks.risk: Corrosion visible on fasteners/housings may indicate long outdoor storage and internal rust
risks.proof: Close-up photos of internal components (valve cover removed, oil pan) showing no rust
risks.if_unproven: priced as moderate corrosion risk, lower grade

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine block casting number or VIN tag confirming LS460 origin
Video of the engine running (cold start, idle, revving)
Photos of the gearbox from multiple angles showing no leaks or cracks
Any documentation or donor vehicle photo showing the LS460 it was removed from
response.reason: The item is clearly a used V8 engine and gearbox assembly, but the LS460/Lexus claim and working condition are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as a generic, unproven-running used engine/gearbox until model and function are confirmed.
